linkedin.text:
🚨 You just spent four hours reading papers that turned out to be dead ends.

Most research tools dump a list and hope you pick the right one. You waste time on low-citation work, methods you can't reproduce, and claims with no code.

Feynman fixes this with transparent PaperRank scoring. It reads citation graphs, checks methods, verifies reproducibility, and surfaces provenance evidence before you waste a single minute.

✅ One command ranks results by what actually matters
✅ Full-text audit compares paper claims against the real codebase
✅ Multi-agent deep research pulls cited briefs from papers, web, and repos

9,012 GitHub stars. MIT licensed. One-line install on macOS, Linux, and Windows.

Search "Feynman AI research agent GitHub" and see the ranked results yourself.

What's the last paper you read that didn't deliver on its abstract promise? 👇
